questions.question: Which of these players went on to be a match referee in a women's test match?
questions.explanation: Fritz was the match referee in the test match between South Africa and England, December 2024.

questions.question: Kei set a database record (22/23 season, List A) with a value of 13. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)', held by Kei.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Titans or Boland?
At which ground did Boland record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — largest win by runs of 533, against Kei on 2011/01/29.

questions.question: How many matches played separate the all-time #1 (Yolandi Potgieter) and #2 (Nonkhululeko Thabethe) players (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Yolandi Potgieter: 212 — Nonkhululeko Thabethe: 207 — a gap of 5.

questions.question: At which ground did Jessica Poley record their career-best innings (49*, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2014/02/08.
